stories.title: Female police officers sue City of Dallas, alleging sex discrimination, retaliation
stories.summary: The two officers allege in the suit that they were harassed due to their sex, and restricted them to partially operational status, stripping them of core duties.

stories.title: Texas Railroad Commissioner-elect joins Inside Texas Politics to discuss priorities, how he plans to double its budget
stories.summary: Jon Rosenthal is the first Democrat Railroad Commissioner in nearly four decades, but he still has to work with two Republicans.

stories.title: Family fights parole approval for woman convicted in deadly Christmas Day drunk-driving crash
stories.summary: A Houston family is fighting the parole approval of a woman convicted in a deadly Christmas Day drunk-driving crash after she served about three years.

stories.title: Holden the Hondo Owl does more than bring school spirit as the mascot. She also signs the national anthem.
stories.summary: Hondo High School is preparing to say goodbye to its Star Signers—a group of seniors, including the mascot, who have signed the national anthem at games for years.

stories.title: 21 indicted in massive Mexican cartel investigation tied to deadly Texas crash, court records say
stories.summary: A sweeping indictment links a violent Mexican cartel to drug and gun trafficking across Texas and a deadly smuggling crash that killed eight people.

stories.title: Hutto's Howdy the Hippo 'pens' tribute to Fiona
stories.summary: Fiona, a beloved hippo who lived at the Cincinnati Zoo, died this week after swallowing a knit hat.

stories.title: 5 things to do in San Antonio this weekend before Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Plenty of places are bringing the fall cheer around the Alamo City.

stories.title: Child alerts family to house fire, helping mother and seven kids escape safely
stories.summary: The family was displaced after an early Friday fire in a west side home’s laundry room left heavy smoke damage throughout the house.

stories.title: Man shot near west side convenience store after armed confrontation, SAPD says
stories.summary: The man was hospitalized in stable condition after a gunman approached him and his partner near a Circle K on Wurzbach Road, according to police.

stories.title: BCSO: Man arrested in online solicitation investigation involving undercover agent posing as teen
stories.summary: A man was arrested Friday on a charge for online solicitation of a minor following an investigation involving BCSO and the U.S. Secret Service.

stories.title: One person dead in 18-wheeler explosion at I-35 on San Antonio's northeast side, police say
stories.summary: The vehicle fire could be seen from traffic cameras at Toepperwein and I-35 on Friday morning.

stories.title: One last love letter: San Antonio Zoo mourns Fiona, Timothy the hippo’s longtime sweetheart
stories.summary: Timothy’s final farewell to Fiona is scheduled for Friday afternoon as San Antonio Zoo remembers a playful romance filled with letters, gifts and birthday surprises.
